g.text: Single RTX 4090 | Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct | Shared background history | 5 paired repeats

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Offset 0 = actual mixed scheduler step. Matched controls use the same repeat, request index and output-token ordinal. Shading = sample SD, n=5.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Engine iteration includes scheduling/host overhead. Client intervals are singleton token-ID SSE arrival gaps; neither is pure GPU kernel time.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Shared-history and independent-history runs are separate. The local window is a diagnostic; it is not claimed to be the paper's measurement window.
